text: The house was perfect and exactly as described in the listing. The kitchen and bathrooms were extremely clean and their were lots of activities to do around the house. I would definitely give 5 stars for the host, location, property, and overall space. The host was helpful and provided clear instructions, which made our stay easy and comfortable.

A small suggestion for future improvement would be to update some of the interior design and bathroom/shower areas. We also noticed that one bathroom had only cold water and no hot water, so that may need some attention.

name: Jacqueline
text:
Overall, we had a great time at Henry's place! We had 13 adults and three children, and we had plenty of space. Henry was easy to work with and I think the house was priced very fairly. The pool is on the smaller side but was very clean and perfect for us having small children. The hot tub was clean but the sauna didn't seem to be working too well. They have a ginormous fridge as well as an additional fridge which was great for a large group!

Note that they do not have pool towels and the towels provided in the home were pretty small so bring your own.

The people that stayed there prior to us did not follow checkout instructions in regard to where to put the trash so animals got into it and we had to clean that up . There was also large boxes left in the garage/game area.

Aside from these small things, we would happily return as everyone truly enjoyed the house!

Thanks!!

name: Nick
text:
I had an absolutely fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described, spotlessly clean, beautifully decorated, and incredibly comfortable. Every little detail was thoughtfully arranged, from the cozy linens to the fully stocked kitchen.
The location was perfect. The host was incredibly responsive and kind, offering great local tips and making sure we had everything we needed throughout our stay.
I genuinely didn’t want to leave and would 100% stay here again next time I’m in the area. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a top-notch Airbnb experience!

name: Rachael
text:
Edward's home in Long Pond is wonderful; you can tell he's put a lot of work and pride into it! The home is filled with everything you might possibly need (even games). It is peaceful, lovely, and quite homey.

While it was too chilly and rainy to get into the pool, the pool is pristine. The hot tub and sauna were our fan favorites. We didn't take advantage of the game room, but it is a great set-up with a huge projector screen. We had dinner for 13 guests in the living room/kitchen area, and the table comfortably accommodated everyone. The multiple stoves/ovens in the kitchen (fully stocked with cook and dinnerware!) were fantastic for cooking with multiple people; we were able to do our thing without being in each other's way(s). The bedrooms are comfortable and nicely decorated - each with it's own AC unit which is helpful. Having three full bathrooms was a godsend.

Edward was super welcoming and responsive from booking to check-out. I cannot recommend this home enough!

name: Toni
text:
Our family had a great time at this Airbnb. The host was very welcoming, communicative and provided clear check-in instructions.

The space itself was spotless and stylish. The kitchen is huge and we loved the open concept of the living layout.

The pool was perfect for cooling off after a hot day. My kids loved the fact that they were able to bring their X-box and play their games on the huge projector.

We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

text: the minutes we walked in we felt like home.clean and organized great place to stay,kids enjoyed the pool and outdoor activities, very responsive,thank Edward for hosting us. definitely will be back .

name: Muhammad
text: Henry’s home was a great experience. The inside is very spacious and beautifully decorated. There are lots of games to play and tvs in most rooms to watch your favorite show. The pool was a little small but still very fun and the hot tub was great. The sauna was very steamy and enjoyable.

name: Michael
text: Such an amazing weekend at Henry’s place. Beautiful, calm, and extremely accommodating in all ways. Would recommend to families, friend getaways or anyone looking for some peace and quiet.

name: Naomi
text: We had a wonderful stay at Henry's place. For a group of 17, it's near impossible to find a home with a dining table big enough for everyone! VERY private- no neighbors or other backyards in view. We did think the kitchen was a bit understocked and missing some basic items, when communicated to Henry and team they immediately provided them at the doorstep, which was much appreciated! Would definitely come back, great host and house.

text: The home was absolutely amazing—truly even better than the pictures. The photos don’t do it justice. Everything about our stay was perfect, from the clear directions and easy check-in to the beautiful space itself. The host was very friendly and highly communicative throughout. I honestly wish we could build a place like this in the future. This has been the best Airbnb I’ve booked since I started using the platform back in 2010. You will love this place—highly recommended!

name: Patricia
text: I would highly recommend Edward's 5 star home. I had a group of 18 people for a retreat. A beautiful, quiet, relaxing home with all of the accommodations that was a hit, the hot tub, sauna, double stoves, big open concept areas that we all be together, game room, outside seating, private pond and grill. The bedrooms were large and very spacious. Edward described the home perfectly. The house was very clean. Edward gave us great instructions and he let me know that he was available, if needed. We will definitely try to get his place next year and would highly recommend to everyone.

There were some minor inconveniences such as the pool cues missing their tops, the jacuzzi tub malfunctioning, and a wobbly bed. But this was not enough for me to take away a star because everything else was working and in tact.

I appreciated that Edward was very professional and helpful in all situations. He is a great host and I would be happy to book with him again.

Thank you Edward for your hospitality.

text: Amazing place to stay! Did a long weekend with the boys to watch some basketball! Perfect place for large groups! Would definitely be looking to book this place again! Thank you such a great stay!

text:
Group of 11 adults who attend a getaway every year. The house had everything we needed. Enjoyed the large living room/kitchen area. Large refrigerator and two stoves were wonderful to have. Beautiful house with many windows to see the snow falling. Quiet, peaceful setting.
Edward was very responsive anytime we had questions.

name: Rhett
text: Booked this for a Bachelor Party and had a blast. Large house with all the amenities for a great weekend. Nice remote location.

name: Jenny
text: Edward has been a great host to us. The property is beautiful and clean. I would recommend this rental to anyone!!

name: Laura
text: I would definitely return to this bnb! Matched the description and was definitely worth it. The host was very responsive and friendly as well.

name: Lauren
text: We had a great stay. Eddie was very responsive and friendly! The house is very clean but could use some TLC… fresh paint, pictures rehung, burnt out lightbulbs replaced & a few cabinets repaired. Overall we had a great time.

name: Vincent
text: Eddie's property was a fantastic find! He was incredibly responsive, ensuring a smooth stay. The place was surprisingly spacious, with a well-equipped kitchen perfect for our cooking needs. The sauna and hot tub were spotless, adding a touch of luxury to our experience. Bedrooms were beautifully decorated, offering clean, comfortable rest. Parking for 6 cars was a breeze. The living room layout was ideal for our group's weekend gathering, making it a cozy spot to connect. Highly recommend for a comfortable, well-maintained stay!

name: Alexander
text: Booked this for a long weekend winter getaway with a large group of friends. Plenty of space and bedding for everybody, spacious kitchen and large dining table for large shared meals, and lots of amenities! The host was very quick to respond to questions from us upon arrival. A big draw was the double oven and stovetop and abundant hang-out space suited for lounging and tabletop games. Situated in a relatively private area in the beautiful Poconos. Would definitely stay again!

name: Olim
text: We had a wonderful rest, a wonderful place to relax with family and friends. Everything is clean and tidy. There are all the necessary things for a vacation. Everything is equipped with taste and amenities. We are very grateful to you.

name: Kaitlyn
text: We stayed for a long weekend. Our stay was clean, fun, and overall a great experience. Eddie was responsive, helpful, and super kind too! We are very pleased with our stay and we hope to come back!

name: Joshua
text: My stay here was great. I stayed with 12 others and we all had a blast. Nobody was bored at all!

name: Khasan
text: Very nice place. So much activities. Clean and described as is

name: Destini
text: I LOVED this stay for my family vacation. I wanted a place that I could bring all my family for a poconos weekend and where we all had space to comfortably stay and this was it. I would definitely come back. Plenty to do at the house for people who didn’t want to go out for activities. 15 mins from Kalahari. And 20 from camelback! When I needed him to be, Edward was very responsive and helpful with any needs. Definitely recommend!

name: Damahny
text: Great house, plenty beds and bathrooms. Great scenery

name: Brenda
text: My family and I really appreciate the easy communication during the holidays.

name: James
text: Great place. Very spacious. Eddie was quick to respond

name: Monica
text: We had a great time staying here! Everything was exactly how it was described and spotless on arrival. We would definitely stay there again!

name: John
text: Edward’s place was nice and had plenty of room for our party. He was very responsive and respectful. The Rooms were big and clean. Great place to entertain a huge group and the ranch layout was a plus because everything was on one floor. The new kitchen was a plus because we had plenty of counter space to prep and the two stoves were handy to cook multiple meals at one time. Definitely would recommend this place to anyone that has a big group that enjoys spending time together in a big home. Thank you Edward!

name: Kathryn
text: Edward was available whenever you needed him. Liked that all was on one floor. The kitchen was amazing. We were there for Thanksgiving and had everything we needed for 14 people. Great time.

name: Rachel
text: I had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb! The host was exceptional – great communicator, clear instructions, and the home was warm and impeccably clean. I would definitely stay here again!

name: Todd
text: Another great year at this house!! Beautiful location and such a large common area to allow all of us to hang out in one area plus the amenities means you’ll never be bored. We will be booking again for next year!

name: Kelsey
text: Magnificent Airbnb! Nestled amidst the serene embrace of nature, the house provided the perfect backdrop for our large group getaway. From the moment we arrived, we were captivated by the tranquility that enveloped us, making it an unforgettable experience. The house itself was not just spacious; it was a sanctuary of cleanliness and comfort. The rooms were cozy, the bathrooms spotless, and the kitchen well-equipped, making our stay incredibly convenient. It's rare to find a place that effortlessly combines luxury with a homely atmosphere like this house. The hosts were exceptional, ensuring our stay was seamless from start to finish. Their warm hospitality and prompt communication made us feel welcome and valued as guests. It was evident that they put a lot of thought and effort into making their property a haven for travelers, and for that, we are truly grateful.

name: Yue
text:
Highly recommend to people looking for a place that offers a perfect blendi of space, aesthetics, seclusion, and fun, this villa is the ultimate choice! The host is super responsive. The villa boasts a large, open space that was perfect for our large group. We never felt cramped; there was room for everyone to relax and enjoy their time comfortably. The aesthetic of the villa is simply breathtaking. Every detail was carefully curated, creating a space that felt both luxurious and inviting. Surrounded by nature and featuring a private pond, we were treated to a serene and peaceful ambiance, far away from the hustle and bustle of city life.
The place offers a lot of amazing amenities and there was something for everyone. We spent our days enjoying the beautiful surroundings, playing games, and watching movies, all within the comfort of the villa. Thanks to the fantastic host for providing us with memories that will last a lifetime. We can't wait to return!

name: Adam
text: House was perfect. Host was very helpful. 10/10

name: David
text: Loved staying at this location. The house was perfect for our group.

name: Luis

name: Bryan
text: This was a great accommodation for our large group of guys. The living area provides a lot of room for group activities, be it cooking, eating, playing pool or ping pong, etc. The garage provides for a nice separation should the group wish to split up or be a bit noisier away from some of the bedrooms. The host seems to do a good job of providing all of the essentials.

name: Regan
text: Amazing spot for a big group to stay in the Poconos. We held 16 people easily for a wedding. Bedrooms and bathrooms laid out very nicely. Amenities we’re great !! Would absolutely recommend and stay again!

name: Cristina
text: My friends and I had a great stay at Edward’s place. He was a great host who was very responsive and accommodating. There were some items that we needed like more paper towels and a grill brush and he ordered them and had them delivered promptly. The house was spacious and accommodated 8 adults and 6 kids comfortably. We really enjoyed the fire pit and cooking meals in the large kitchen. Thank you for a nice stay.

name: Reut
text: Great place to stay! we enjoyed our time at Edward's place, lots of games for kids, very spacious and comfortable.

name: Marlenis
text: Very large open concept home. The kitchen was super modern, well stocked and large enough to comfortably cook for a large group. Very spacious home with many activities to do inside. So much that we didn’t have enough time to do it all! We will definitely be coming back again next year! The house was so clean and everything was ready when we arrived that we felt right at home! We just relaxed, unpacked and enjoyed our stay! Edward was a great host that responded to everything we needed in a timely fashion and worked with us very well to accommodate our stay

name: Zachary
text: Great house! Very comfortable, fun and we had a great time!

name: Tom
text: Our group had an amazing time during our stay at this house! It had everything we needed and was exactly as pictured. Eddie was a ton of help, communicated everything clearly, and was very friendly/accomodating. We will certainly consider staying here again next year!

name: Daniel
text: I stayed here with a large group of friends and had an incredible experience. We had plenty of space and Edward was super responsive and helpful. The backyard is beautiful and we even saw a bear!

name: Gladys
text: Edward was a great host. He gave us clear instructions once we booked our stay from check in to check out. Eddie was very accommodating and attentive to our needs. Five stars for Edward!! Thanks for making our stay one we will never forget!!

name: Jack

Great stay, great house, great host!
Highly recommended.

name: Hui
text: It was an amazing stay at Eddie’s place in Long pond with my family. Eddie was very quick in responding to our needs and questions. Would definitely recommend his place for a large family get together!

We would love to come back when it doesn't rain the whole time so that we can enjoy the outside of the property next time.

name: Connor
text:
Eddie was a highly responsive host and was quick to answer all of my questions about the property. He answered all of my questions in the days leading up to our stay quickly and politely. I'd definitely stay here again. It was a perfect place for our weekend getaway, and even with our group of 10 we had plenty of room to spare! The large space, along with all the different amenities, make it a perfect place to stay with a large group even if you don't want to travel anywhere outside the property. We particularly enjoyed the hot-tub and sauna during our stay!

Eddie was a great host!

Highly recommend!

name: Alice

name: Cesar

name: Vedant
text: Really nice place to enjoy with 10 to 14 people

name: Andrew
text: Great location for a large group, Eddie is very helpful and responsive, thanks!

name: Shivanna
text: We had an amazing time! So much to do! So much space! Had an amazing time! Will definitely be back!

name: Melissa
text: This place is great for large groups. So many things to keep you busy. The pool table, air hockey, hot tub, sauna etc. were high quality! The kitchen is very accommodating for large groups - with 2 stoves (both have dbl ovens), double wide refrigerator, and a huge island with extra sink! Perfect for hosting. Plenty of beds. Any questions we had during our stay were handled very timely and professionally. Eddie is a great host! Can’t wait to come back with the rest of my family!

name: Ramsey
text: An amazing house with a ton of space for a large family or gathering of friends. There was ample space for everyone. The common areas had something for everyone. The house was clean. The host was responsive and very polite. I would revisit this place.

name: Erica
text: Great place - perfect for family time together! Bedrooms are equally sized and all bathrooms are accessible to everyone. Laundry was great - and facilities/game room as described!

name: Katie
text: I had my husbands 30th birthday party at Eddie’s place and it was wonderful. There was plenty of beds and space for everyone to be comfortable and have their own space. The house is filled with all sorts of games and plenty of seating. Eddie was very responsive to all my questions and was a great host. I would definitely recommend his place to anyone!

name: Adam
text: Eddie's place was perfect for our outing including 15 total people. The industrial fridge was really nice to have. All the beds were comfortable and we appreciated that they were evenly spread out amongst all the rooms. The house was a perfect hang-out space for a big group with lots of seating, games, and other things to do. Nearby to walmart for supplies but far enough out of the way that it felt secluded. Highly Recommend.

name: Richard
text: A great spot, there was plenty of space even for 15 of us. The house had a lot to do and wasn’t too far from Stroudsberg which opened up a lot of opportunities.

name: Ethan
text: Eddie was very responsive and the place was exactly as described. We all enjoyed our stay and would return.

name: Pornthiwa
text: The house was good as they advertised. Very clean, neat, huge, and fit our needs. All of the amenities provided in the house kept our group entertained. The kitchen is pretty big with a huge refrigerator that can stock up anything you want. The host is very friendly, and responsive. We would recommend this house and we would definitely come back again.

name: Felicia
text: We had a fantastic stay at Eddie's house. The house itself is beautiful and perfect for our group! My family especially enjoyed the pool table, hot tub, game table, and movie screen. My teen/college age chilren really liked the garage are which had a game table, refrigerator/freezer, sectional couch, and move screen. We hooked a phone up to the projector and used spotify so that the music lyrics projected onto the screen. We did Karaoke and it was awesome having the lyrics projected onto the huge screen. The best part about it is that you could not hear any of the noise from the garage/room when you were inside the house. The kitchen is an absolute dream and I wish I could take home the refrigerator to my house. It was a double refrigerator that fit all of our perishable items and trays of prepared food. My family enjoyed the stay so much that they want to book Eddie's house again. Eddie was fantastic and communicated promptly throughout the process. Awesome host/house!!!

name: Joseph
text: The home was as advertised and good for our trip. We would Recommend it to others.

name: Randy
text: Easy check in. Eddie communicated with us very well. We had all the information needed before check in. Eddie answered any questions we had immediately after we messaged. I would definitely stay here again.

name: Moshe
text: Stayed here for a few nights and couldn’t be better! Host was very nice and was very accommodating. House was very clean and neat. Would highly recommend this for anybody!

name: Jessica
text: Eddies home was absolutely perfect! He was so responsive and helpful ! The house was so gorgeous and peaceful we extended our stay. We will absolutely be returning and have not stopped raving about our stay since we returned. The kitchen has everything you could need and more if you’re looking to cook or order in from one of the many places nearby! Beds were so comfortable and there’s so much to do just in the house alone ! I would rate it higher than 5 stars if I could! Thank you Eddie for the gorgeous home and wonderful hospitality

name: Samantha
text:
Our group is still RAVING about Eddie's place! We had a big group and the place was even bigger than we expected! Even though the Wiki Cabin had plenty of space, it was still extremely cozy...talk about the best of both worlds. The location was the perfect mix of private and convenient (~20 minutes away from Camelback). However, you do not even need to leave the house if you do not want to due to the extension amenity offerings.

Eddie made the entire process beyond seamless. We booked his humble abode about 6/7 months in advance and he was incredibly responsive the entire time. The information he provided in the months, weeks, and days leading up to our stay made it even more accommodating for such a large group. Not only was Eddie responsive, but he was patient with all of my questions and was also extremely flexible.

If you're looking for a weekend getaway to the mountains with a large group...click that book button. I can promise that you will not be disappointed!

name: Linda
text:
I would definitely stay there again, so much space, and lots of things to do in and out of the property.
Went in the winter, so didn’t go outside, but definitely stuff to do

name: Iryna
text:
We had a wonderful time at this location. The house is great for a large group. The ski resorts and water parks are near by and there is plenty of parking on the property. You do not see any neighbors and have your privacy. We were able to enjoy the fire pit outside in the snow and grill.

The hot tub and sauna did not get hot enough to enjoy, but mainly because that room is attached to the porch. There is no heating system there for the room. There is a separate game room which has a poker table, air hockey and card games with a projector for movie nights. We would definitely stay here again. Our host was very responsive to all requests/inquiries and made.

I would recommend putting together a book with the community rules to have in the home. This way your guests are informed about any additional rules there might be.

name: Susan
text: Large and great layout for multiple families, especially with the 2 separate wings for bedrooms. Liked the multiple living areas so families can spread out. Lots of things to do inside the house (pool table, foosball table, air hockey, video games, etc). Large kitchen, large fridge, and large table was nice for all to gather. Peaceful and private lot, close enough to mountain to ski. Parts of the house could use a refresh, update (bathrooms, kitchen cabinets) and floor needs a good scrubbing but overall a good stay for multiple families.

name: Monica
text: Eddie was a wonderful host - extremely responsive and communicative. Our group of 16 loved the house; it was so spacious and the layout was perfect for a big group dinner. We enjoyed being within 20 min of Camelback, breweries, grocery stores and more while having privacy at the house itself. Would absolutely recommend staying here! Winter getaway was a big success and would bet summers are a dream too.

name: Victoria
text:
eddie was an amazing host and had a beautiful home! he was always quick to respond and accommodate any questions or concerns.

the house looks exactly like the photos. it was so spacious and the backyard is gorgeous. thank you eddie!

name: Nancy
text:
Overall good stay! We loved the layout of the house\the amenities it offered, such as the hot tub\sauna room with projector screen & pool table. My family of 12 & 1 baby would visit again but be more prepared..
The house was clean but needed some TLC. Beds are not that comfy but we all slept fine. House definitely needs to be updated, dishwasher was coming out of the counter & completely fell out while we were trying to use it so be careful trying to open it, some window panes were broken\hard to open. Some stove tops don't work & the writing's rubbed off so you can't tell how to turn the temperature? there's only like 3 oven pans\big bowls so if you are trying to cook for a large family, you need to bring your own stuff.. There was no oil to cook with\trash bags\paper towels so plan accordingly.. we couldn't find a broom either. trash shed was overflowing with trash. fire detector is super sensitive. but we loved the huge fridge, long dining table, Island and swing chair! Good host!

name: Ivan
text: Great place, nice set up and perfect for our family trip

name: Jill
text: Overall a great space for a large group. Our family (group of 17) enjoyed the spacious layout and in house activities like the pool table and air hockey. The location is nice and quiet too. Good space for a family get away!

name: Steven
text: Renting out Eddie’s home for a vacation was amazing! Check in and check out was smooth, the home was very well furnished and had very nice vibes to it! The host was very helpful and responsive too. 10/10 would book with this host! :)

name: Matthew
text: Great place exactly like the pictures. Would definitely come back to snowboard around.

name: Sasha
text:
My family stayed at Eddie's for a family vacation, and we could not have chosen a better spot. There's a lot of us and there was enough room that everyone felt they had their own space and early morning noise in the kitchen/living room didn't carry over, whoever wanted to sleep in could sleep in in peace.
Eddie was a super responsive host and even sent us Uber eats breakfast our first day, which was above and beyond as a host.
The cabin is within about 30 minutes of a few of the ski slopes, so even if you get bored with one, you can go to another.
We also managed to do professional family photos there because it was that gorgeous of a backyard.
All in all, it is a fantastic place to stay, and I would recommend it to anyone!

name: Raj
text: Home was lovely! We had a great time, it was spacious, ranch style housing. Rooms were separated from the action nicely. Would definitely come back!

name: Sharon
text: We celebrated Thanksgiving at Eddie’s house. We had a great time with all the house had to offer. It was well stocked with supplies and lots of room for everyone! Eddie was always available if we had a problem or question. Would definitely come back again!

name: Stephanie
text:
The house was gorgeous, huge, and fit our needs perfectly! The stay was wonderful and we would definitely come back.

We had a Friendsgiving here for 12 and the kitchen was able to accommodate our large number of cooks in the kitchen, with a ton of counter space and 2 stoves (and the extra sink was a lifesaver). The dining table was also able to sit our whole group comfortably.

There was tons of living space for a large group to hang out, extra beds and plenty of bathrooms. Not to mention the pool table, jacuzzi/sauna and other activities/amenities. The pond in the yard was beautiful too!

name: James
text: Great, large house for gatherings with tons of activities. Everything you need is within a 20min drive from the house. It's hard to find a house that comfortably sleeps this many but this place stays true to the description. Great spot!

name: Todd
text: House is gorgeous with a large common area for everyone to relax and hangout. Will definitely be going back.

name: May
text: Wonderful place for a group tour. Our reunion is super in such housing. Thanks for the facilities and services!

name: Thomas
text:
My family and I couldn’t have asked for a better house and host than this! We truly loved everything about the property and the home was even nicer than pictured. Everything was awesome and we especially loved all of the games, the hot tub, and the back yard space! Having everything on one level made the trip easier for the grandparents and was definitely a big plus.
Wei and Yue were awesome host who were readily available and quick to respond to any questions We look forward to staying again and definitely suggest this home for any of your big group vacation needs :)

name: Roro
text: A great design of vacation house. It is well setup to meet different family needs.

name: Winnie
text:
Big open home to fit my group (all adults)! The open space was great since it kept us all together even when we split into smaller groups to play games at the little tables or billiards.

The dual range and oven made heating up food more convenient. The pool table and foldable ping pong table attachment (not in photos) were thoroughly enjoyed. The WiFi seemed strong enough (I didn’t speed test) for some remote work and online gaming. The outdoor deck and grill area is spacious. The pool can fit approx 8 donut floaties and 10 of us were in the pool comfortably. Hand soap, dish soap & pods, toilet paper, trash bags, and one set of towels were available. ACs worked well and kept the home cool.

We did spot 2 deer on the drive in but none during our stay.

FYI: rooms 1-4 and 2 bathrooms are on one side of the house while rooms 5-6 and the 3rd bathroom is near the movie room side.

Wei is very responsive and checked in on us to make sure everything was OK. Thanks for the donuts - a bit too sweet so we packed up on our way home to enjoy later :)

name: Vivian
text: Great place to stay for a large group with many amenities and entertainment.

name: Eric
text: Great place for a group get together, with lots of activities for everyone

name: Jennifer
text: We had a great time, the place is beautiful and has everything you need. Our family loved spending time with each other there. There were 14 of us and we did not feel like we were on top of each other, there was plenty of things to do. Our kids loved the game room and movie theater. Wei gets back to you right away if you have any questions about the house or need something specific. We would definitely recommend to others.

name: Jeffrey
text: Our extended family had a great stay at Wei's house. There were lots of things to do both inside and outside. The property was clean and well-maintained. Wei was very responsive. Our trip exceeded our high expectations!

name: Andrew
text: A+ experience. It was absolutely perfect for our large group and we could not have asked for a better home. The owners even sent donuts and coffee for us in the morning was such a great touch. I would highly recommend this home for any large group and will recommend this to anyone heading to the Poconos.

name: Sheri
text: It was a beautiful home ! Very big and spacious. Back yard was amazing to hangout in every evening or even during the day. Communication was perfect! Would love to go back! My family and I really enjoyed ourselves.

name: Maureen
text: We had a great time at Wiki Villa. We love the fully-equipped kitchen, we had everything we need. Kitchen is spacious with big island countertop, the big long table that we made good use of it. We love the sauna, everyone enjoyed it. Wei is easy to communicate with. The place is huge, lots of fun things to do as well as relaxation.

name: Lauren
text: Hosted a bachelorette party here and we had a blast!

name: Neethu
text: The cabin is well stocked and has all the amenities you need. We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it for anyone looking to get away!

name: Diane
text: We very highly recommend Wei's home for a family get together! It was spacious and clean. The kitchen was well equipped with all that is needed to prepare meals. Our grandchildren really enjoyed the swimming pool and the game room. They enjoyed watching movies on the big screen! Wei was quick to respond to questions and all that we needed to know to make our vacation very memorable!!!

name: Jamin
text: If you’re looking for a pleasant and quiet stay with your family, this is the spot! This place is much more vast and spacious than what it seems in the photos, and there are countless ways to have fun with your loved ones within it! Wei was an amazing host!!! They made sure to provide clear directions to navigate through our experience, addressed all our concerns and was very responsive when we reached out to them!

name: Katrina
text:
Even though my family and few friends joined me to help celebrate my birthday, Wiki Villa was immensely therapeutic for each and everyone of us. We just wished we had more days to enjoy all the amenities over and over.
If you need a zen/peaceful ambiance with everything and more at your disposal, that’s the place to be. When i say everything you could think of… I mean EVERYTHING. I loved the sauna and hot tub room. Endless games, if fusbal isn’t your strong suit, there’s poker, connect 4, card games, pool, ping pong, dominoes. If you dont want to watch tv in your room, you can lounge in the beautiful living open area and watch tv there. You want to catch up on your show but also soak in the hot tub, theres a tv in there also. Ahh man, i only came back today and I’m feeling nostalgic. My family is full and want more. We definitely created memories this weekend. Only thing i have left to say is BOOK IT!

Thank you Wei and Wiki Villa for hosting us.

name: Srinath
text: Excellent stay, we had a great time place was in a great location.

name: Diane
text: Our group consisted of grandparents, the kids and the grandkids. We had 4 couples and 8 grandchildren ranging in age from 23 to 1. The house is laid out so there is plenty room for everyone. Would definitely stay here again and the host was so quick to answer any and all questions.

name: Matthew
text: This property was absolutely amazing. The house was very clean and all of the amenities kept our entire group entertained for the duration of our stay. The hosts are also great and have great communication. Would definitely recommend this property for your next vacation!

name: Md
text: Nice location to stay but the villa is kind of old and the beds are not that comfortable, Mr. Wei was a good host.

name: Donisha
text: We had a great time at the Wiki Villa. Everything was amazing and clean. The house is beautiful very spacious and lots of things to do. Wei was a great communicator and made sure to respond to all our questions quickly. Definitely would stay here again.

name: Khushbu
text: Wei is a wonderful host and communicated regularly to sort any issues or check in if we needed anything. The home is cosy and cute, and it has pretty much everything we could have needed for a family vacation, at a great location. Would definitely recommend, specially for larger groups.

name: Dennis
text: Our group had fun here. The property is cool. Big center room is plenty of fun for everyone. Outside by pond is nice too

name: Steve
text: we had a group of 16 people staying this place over the weekend, we all had a very good experiences. host is a very nice person. very easy to Communicate. rooms are all very clean. strongly recommended .

name: Sharon
text:
Wei's place in the Poconos is the house to rent especially if you have a large group. at no point did we feel crowded. the house is all one level with huge bedrooms at both sides. there were 3 bathrooms that had toiletries and were big as well. leave your towels and sheets at home because they were provided as well. if you have toddlers or babies they even had 2 high chairs and a pack and play. tvs were in pretty much all the rooms I believe. the kitchen was fully stocked and spacious and we could all sit together to eat or play at the dining table. the refrigerator was huge so you can stock up anything you want. the backyard had a big 5' pool -they even provided vests if needed. the deck had a grill as well and an extra tank. there was a nice little pond in the backyard as well with a fountain- very scenic for early mornings and dusk. please bring bug spray because you are in the middle of the woods and will get bitten!
inside there was a hot tub and sauna.
communication with the host was excellent! they were very quick to reply and even had doughnuts sent to us the next day. they were in touch with us the whole time in case we were in need of anything. I would definitely recommend staying at Wei's house for your next trip.

name: Chelsea

name: Guest
text: By far the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed out, Yue & Wei’s house is the perfect getaway location for a large group looking to enjoy all that the Poconos has to offer. My group of 16 slept comfortably and had room for at least two more on beds. We were able to eat together at one table and hang in the living room all at once. The house had plenty to do when we weren’t all together, with the movie/game room and hot tub being our favorite locations. For those who cook, the kitchen has two sets of stoves and ovens, along with plenty of cookware, pots, and storage space (the biggest fridge I’ve ever seen). Lastly, the driveway had room for all of our cars (9) and may have been able to fit one more. Hope you enjoy your stay as much as we did; Yue & Wei are the perfect hosts who make check-in seamless and answer questions quicker than should be humanly possible lol. Amazing property from top to bottom!
